mapper.sql: hit_id AS hitId, screening_run_id AS screeningRunId, external_hit_ref AS externalHitRef, entity_type AS entityType, match_type AS matchType, match_score AS matchScore, risk_level AS riskLevel, status, version, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_screening_hit(hit_id, screening_run_id, external_hit_ref, entity_type, match_type, match_score, risk_level, status, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{row.hitId}, #{row.screeningRunId}, #{row.externalHitRef}, #{row.entityType}, #{row.matchType}, #{row.matchScore}, #{row.riskLevel}, #{row.status}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_screening_hit WHERE screening_run_id IN #{id} ORDER BY screening_run_id, hit_id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_screening_hit SET status = 'RESOLVED', version = version + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE hit_id = #{row.hitId} AND version = #{row.version} AND status = 'OPEN'
